blocks.fleet-v1:
Host safety (fleet-v1):
- Do not start local database servers. Database integration tests belong in CI.
- Run only tests for what you changed locally; leave full suites to CI.
- Stop every fixture or background process you start, by its PID, before finishing.
- Work only in a worktree, never in the canonical checkout.
- Reporting upward (READY, ESC, other notices): ESC asks a question and the job stays open. Difficulty or size is never a reason to stop. If the parent is operator-desk or a claude pane, use only `panewire emit --kind lane.event` (escalate an ESC with `--type decision`, report being stuck with `--type blocked`) and never write into that pane with herdr prompt/send-text/send-keys; emit rc 0 is enough even when you cannot see the receiver, so do not raise an ESC about delivery. Only if the parent pane is codex or devin (which do not receive lane.event): emit, then `herdr agent prompt` to that parent pane once and confirm it landed.
- Completion: a report file alone never completes a job. READY or DONE in a lane.event from this pane completes the job once the report exists and has stopped changing; an optional `[label] ` prefix is allowed. `panewire done` completes directly. `panewire escalate` stops with a reason. ESC asks a question and keeps the job open. Difficulty or size is never a reason to stop.
